standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T144956Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after a fix. The BLS PPI and CPI series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. tools/check.py --all passes for this issue. One correction is recorded here because it changed the computed set: issue.py built its series map from the named run alone, so the two sources that state one period per issue, the Dairy Market News CME reprint and shell egg report 2848, could carry no comparison at all. Both are now declared accumulates in sources.json, and the shell egg prices carry a trailing four-week average: 71.81 cents a dozen national delivered warehouse and 44.50 Midwest paid to producers, against the latest weeks of 66.19 and 38.00. Remaining gaps: neither the CME butter series nor the shell egg series carries a year-over-year figure yet, the record holding five weeks of each. The NASS average-layers and table-egg-production figures are for 2026-08, the newest month published, and carry no two-year comparison. The weekly egg market overview is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. The September baseline has not been recomputed.
